comment: Fine with Aren Levy Lane if the signs still make it clear this is a public lane.

condition.requirement: Keep public-lane access clear on the new signage.

comment: Please give businesses a written explanation of whether delivery addresses need updating before the new signs go up.

condition.requirement: Notify nearby businesses of any delivery-address changes before installing signs.

comment: I could support the hotel if there is an enforceable quiet-hours plan for guests arriving late. The entrance is the bit I worry about.

condition.requirement: Provide an enforceable quiet-hours and late-arrival management plan.

comment: Restaurant deliveries need a booked loading arrangement. Do not leave trucks idling outside nearby homes.

condition.requirement: Schedule restaurant deliveries and prevent idling beside nearby homes.

comment: A restaurant could be good here, provided the waste storage is indoors and collections are scheduled.

condition.requirement: Provide indoor waste storage and scheduled collections.

comment: Show the step-free route from the sidewalk all the way to reception, not just a symbol on a drawing.

condition.requirement: Publish a continuous step-free access route from sidewalk to hotel reception.

comment: Would support it with a construction contact who actually answers and advance notice of the loud work.

condition.requirement: Name a construction contact and give advance notice of noisy work.

comment: Need the old and proposed prices side by side. A link to a whole budget appendix is hard to work through.

condition.requirement: Publish an accessible side-by-side list of existing and proposed fees.

comment: I would support the package if people on low incomes have a clear, usable fee-relief route.

condition.requirement: Provide a clear fee-relief process for people on low incomes.

comment: Give businesses notice of the final rates before they take effect so we can budget for them.

condition.requirement: Provide advance notice of final rates and their effective dates.

comment: Explain which services the new fees pay for and how that money will be tracked.

condition.requirement: Publish the service rationale and revenue reporting for new fees.

comment: Can support changes if the impact on frequent users is published, including people paying several fees together.

condition.requirement: Publish the combined impact of the changes on frequent service users.

comment: More flexible hours are okay with me if noise complaints still have a clear response process.

condition.requirement: Retain a clear noise-complaint response process when operating hours change.

comment: I support simpler registers provided there is a sample showing exactly what records we must keep.

condition.requirement: Provide a sample of the goods-register records businesses must retain.

comment: Put the licensing and zoning definitions in one guide. I need to know whether my operation fits both.

condition.requirement: Publish one guide explaining how the licensing and zoning definitions apply together.

comment: Happy to see the old videotape licence go if existing licensees are told what happens to renewals and any prepaid fees.

condition.requirement: Notify existing videotape-store licensees how renewals and prepaid fees will be handled.

comment: I could back the fee update if there is a transition rule for applications already being prepared.

condition.requirement: Publish a transition rule for applications in preparation when fees change.

comment: Show the actual before-and-after amounts for each of those reference numbers in plain language.

condition.requirement: Publish existing and proposed amounts for each affected site-plan fee.

comment: Please show how the fees relate to the cost of reviewing applications, and report on that after implementation.

condition.requirement: Explain the review-cost basis for the fees and publish follow-up reporting.

comment: I would support this if community access has guaranteed hours in the lease, rather than being left to an announcement later.

condition.requirement: Guarantee specific community-access hours in the lease.

comment: Publish the booking rules and prices for the community amenities before signing.

condition.requirement: Publish community-amenity booking rules and prices before the lease is signed.

comment: A long lease needs public reporting on whether the promised community access actually happens.

condition.requirement: Require public reporting on delivery of community-access commitments.

comment: Could support a practice facility if the community spaces have step-free entrances and accessible changing facilities.

condition.requirement: Provide step-free access and accessible changing facilities for community users.

comment: Support would depend on a delivery and event-traffic plan that keeps nearby entrances usable.

condition.requirement: Provide a delivery and event-traffic plan that maintains nearby entrance access.

comment: I could support the homes if construction always leaves a protected pedestrian route along the site.

condition.requirement: Maintain a protected pedestrian route along the site throughout construction.

comment: More homes makes sense to me provided a defined share is secured as affordable housing, with the terms made public.

condition.requirement: Secure a defined affordable-housing share and publish the terms.

comment: Please publish a wind study showing what the sidewalks would feel like, plus the changes needed if conditions are poor.

condition.requirement: Publish a pedestrian wind study and the measures needed to address poor conditions.

comment: Would back the separate commercial building if loading can happen without blocking neighbouring business entrances.

condition.requirement: Design loading for the non-residential building to keep neighbouring entrances clear.

comment: Show where delivery vehicles and pickups will stop so they are not left using the travel lanes.

condition.requirement: Provide designated delivery and pickup space outside travel lanes.

comment: I would support the non-residential space if its public entrances are step-free from the sidewalk.

condition.requirement: Provide step-free sidewalk access to public non-residential entrances.

comment: My support depends on a written right-to-return process for affected social-housing tenants, with a named person to contact.

condition.requirement: Publish a written right-to-return process and named contact for affected social-housing tenants.

comment: Need a phase-by-phase relocation plan before any moves, including who pays the moving costs.

condition.requirement: Publish the relocation sequence and responsibility for moving costs before moves begin.

comment: I would support the affordable homes if the affordability period and eligibility rules are secured and published.

condition.requirement: Secure and publish the affordable homes’ affordability period and eligibility rules.

comment: Would support the parks if usable step-free routes reach the seating and play areas.

condition.requirement: Provide step-free park routes connecting entrances, seating and play areas.

comment: Show how the market buildings fit into the construction sequence and when people get their streets back.

condition.requirement: Publish the market-building construction sequence and street-access milestones.

comment: Please keep a clearly signed walking route through each work phase, with changes posted ahead of time.

condition.requirement: Maintain signed walking routes and announce route changes before each work phase.

comment: I can support the community spaces if residents help set the booking rules and the fees are published before opening.

condition.requirement: Involve residents in community-space booking rules and publish fees before opening.

comment: I support designation if the conservation approach still allows accessibility improvements at the arena.

condition.requirement: Allow accessibility improvements within the arena conservation approach.

comment: Please explain which parts of the arena would be protected and what routine repairs owners could still do.

condition.requirement: Publish a plain-language guide to protected arena attributes and routine repairs.

comment: Would support protecting it if there is a public maintenance plan with responsibilities spelled out.

condition.requirement: Publish a maintenance plan identifying who is responsible for the protected attributes.

comment: Put the exact pieces proposed for closure on a readable street map, with the remaining public routes marked.

condition.requirement: Publish a readable parcel map showing the closure limits and remaining public routes.

comment: I could support closing those portions if the plan confirms which walking connections remain available.

condition.requirement: Confirm and publish the walking connections that remain available after closure.

comment: Before approval, explain whether any loading or servicing access is affected and how it would be maintained.

condition.requirement: Explain any servicing-access impacts and the arrangements for maintaining access.

comment: I would support the new housing if patients keep a step-free route to the retained medical building throughout construction.

condition.requirement: Maintain step-free patient access to the retained medical building throughout construction.

comment: Could support the homes with construction hours and a complaints contact published before work begins.

condition.requirement: Publish construction hours and a complaints contact before work begins.

comment: We need deliveries and patient drop-offs separated from the construction vehicles. Show the arrangement.

condition.requirement: Separate medical deliveries and patient drop-offs from construction vehicle routes.

comment: Please show the shadow impacts on neighbouring properties by season, not just one view.

condition.requirement: Publish seasonal shadow studies for neighbouring properties.

comment: Support depends on clear signs from the street when the medical entrance route changes during the works.

condition.requirement: Provide clear street-to-entrance signs whenever medical access routes change during construction.

comment: I would support the threshold change if operators get a written explanation of which licence they need instead.

condition.requirement: Give affected operators written guidance on their applicable licence category.

comment: Fine with the smaller-venue change if there is still a straightforward way to report late-night noise and get a response.

condition.requirement: Maintain a clear late-night noise-complaint and response process for affected venues.

comment: Need a transition guide that checks zoning and licensing together before anyone is asked to switch categories.

condition.requirement: Publish coordinated zoning and licensing transition guidance before category changes.

comment: Please explain how occupant load is verified, rather than leaving customers to guess from the licence name.

condition.requirement: Explain how occupant load is verified for the definition threshold.

comment: Could support alignment if the city reviews how it works after a year and publishes the problems found.

condition.requirement: Publish a one-year review of implementation issues after alignment takes effect.

comment: I could support the exclusion if prospective tenants are told clearly, before signing, that these addresses cannot get area 1E permits.

condition.requirement: Require clear pre-lease disclosure of area 1E permit ineligibility at the excluded addresses.

comment: Explain how disability-related loading and pickup needs would be handled for people living in the development.

condition.requirement: Publish arrangements for disability-related loading and pickups at the development.

comment: Need a plain map of the changed permit boundary and an effective date so staff do not rely on old information.

condition.requirement: Publish the revised permit boundary and its effective date.

comment: Would support this if there is a named contact for correcting an address or eligibility error.

condition.requirement: Provide a named contact and process for correcting address or eligibility errors.

comment: I can support a simpler process if neighbours still get notice and a chance to comment before a decision.

condition.requirement: Retain advance notice and an opportunity for neighbours to comment on exclusions.

comment: A single schedule would help provided the online address list is searchable and dated whenever it changes.

condition.requirement: Publish a searchable excluded-address schedule with revision dates.

comment: Please show who made each decision and where someone can request a correction or review.

condition.requirement: Publish the decision-maker and correction or review route for each exclusion.

comment: I would support the wider protection if the timber-frame attributes are mapped clearly enough to guide future repairs.

condition.requirement: Clearly map the protected timber-frame attributes for future repairs.

comment: Could support the expanded history if there is a readable public explanation of the associations being recognized.

condition.requirement: Provide a readable public explanation of the historical associations being recognized.

comment: Need guidance on compatible repairs and accessibility alterations so the protection is workable day to day.

condition.requirement: Publish guidance on compatible repairs and accessibility alterations.

comment: Show worked examples for one tree and several trees, including what makes an application complex.

condition.requirement: Publish worked tree-fee examples and the criteria used to assess application complexity.

comment: I could support the flat grade-alteration fee if the city explains what work it covers and what requires a separate application.

condition.requirement: Explain the scope of the standalone grade-alteration fee and when separate applications are required.

comment: Would support the fee structure if payment is clearly separated from permission to do the work.

condition.requirement: Make clear in fee guidance that payment does not authorize work without approval.

comment: Since the fees are non-refundable, please offer a way to check the required application type before paying.

condition.requirement: Provide an application-type check before applicants pay non-refundable fees.

comment: I could support the sign fee if tenants can still see the current building rating while a replacement sign is being issued.

condition.requirement: Keep the current building rating accessible to tenants during sign replacement.

comment: Publish the precise exemption criteria and the documents a social-housing provider needs to supply.

condition.requirement: Publish social-housing exemption criteria and required documentation.

comment: Would support remedial-work fees if residents get a clear update on what work was ordered and whether it was completed.

condition.requirement: Give residents clear updates on ordered remedial work and its completion.

comment: Need itemized remedial-work bills and a clear way to challenge an error.

condition.requirement: Provide itemized remedial-work bills and a process for disputing errors.

comment: I support exemptions provided the inspection and repair expectations for exempt buildings are explained publicly.

condition.requirement: Publicly explain inspection and repair expectations for buildings receiving fee exemptions.

comment: Would support the purchase only once Council has actually approved the permanent closure and the limits are public.

condition.requirement: Complete Council approval of permanent closure and publish its limits before the purchase proceeds.

comment: Please show any access or servicing rights that have to remain in place before the lane portions are sold.

condition.requirement: Identify and protect any required access or servicing rights before sale.

comment: Publish the basis for the sale price and the final terms, subject to the usual privacy limits.

condition.requirement: Publish the valuation basis and disclosable final sale terms.

comment: Show the exact Dundas pieces on a street-level map, including where pedestrians would still cross.

condition.requirement: Map the specified Dundas closure portions and remaining pedestrian crossings.

comment: I could support the Kipling portion closing if a continuous step-free walking route is shown on the final plan.

condition.requirement: Show a continuous step-free walking route in the final Kipling closure plan.

comment: Would support the Bloor portion if servicing access to affected properties is confirmed before it closes.

condition.requirement: Confirm servicing access to affected properties before the specified Bloor portion closes.

comment: Please put signs on site before the change so people can see what remains public and what is closing.

condition.requirement: Install advance on-site signs identifying closure boundaries and remaining public routes.

comment: Before demolition, release the heritage documentation in a public archive people can actually find.

condition.requirement: Make the pre-demolition heritage documentation publicly accessible in an archive.

comment: I could support the replacement arrangements if a route and access plan is published before any change to the crossing.

condition.requirement: Publish route and access arrangements before changes to the crossing.

comment: Would support the salvage approach if there is an inventory saying what is kept, where it goes and how it will be interpreted.

condition.requirement: Publish an inventory of retained bridge material, its destination and interpretation plans.

comment: Need the temporary-bridge stage and the permanent replacement stage explained separately, including when updates will be issued.

condition.requirement: Publish separate temporary and permanent bridge stages with a schedule for progress updates.

comment: I support reopening applications if pitches leave a continuous clear path for wheelchairs and people with strollers.

condition.requirement: Require a continuous unobstructed pedestrian path at sidewalk-vending pitches.

comment: Longer mobile vending hours work for me if there is a waste plan and a clear contact for problems late in the day.

condition.requirement: Require waste management and a late-hours complaints contact for extended mobile vending.

comment: Please put all permit steps, documents and fees in one checklist before the new regime starts.

condition.requirement: Publish one checklist of permit steps, documents and fees before the new regime starts.

comment: I could support licensing on-foot sellers if the application is available on paper as well as online.

condition.requirement: Provide both paper and online application routes for on-foot vendor licences.

comment: Need a site plan that keeps neighbouring shop entrances and deliveries usable, not just a mark for the cart.

condition.requirement: Require pitch plans to preserve neighbouring shop entrances and delivery access.

comment: Would support longer stays if the posted permit makes it easy to check where and when that vendor may operate.

condition.requirement: Display permit information showing the vendor’s authorized location and operating times.

comment: I could support the transfer if the plan confirms that access to the library is kept usable.

condition.requirement: Confirm how usable library access will be maintained after the parcel transfer.

comment: Please show the 32.6 square metres on a readable map and explain the intended municipal use before the transfer.

condition.requirement: Publish a readable parcel map and explain the intended municipal use before transfer.

comment: I could support the alterations if the conservation and relocation plan is available publicly before the heritage work starts.

condition.requirement: Make the conservation and relocation plan public before heritage work begins.

comment: Document the specific attribute being removed with measured drawings and photographs before it goes.

condition.requirement: Prepare measured drawings and photographs of the specified heritage attribute before removal.

comment: Would support the conservation work if progress is checked by a qualified heritage professional and reported publicly.

condition.requirement: Require qualified heritage oversight and public reporting on conservation work.

comment: Need the construction access plan to show a protected walking route past the site during the alteration work.

condition.requirement: Maintain a protected walking route past the site during alteration work.

comment: I could support the proposed sale if the exact parcel and any access rights that remain are clearly mapped.

condition.requirement: Clearly map the sale parcel and any access rights that must remain.

comment: Please explain the valuation basis and make the disclosable sale terms public before the decision.

condition.requirement: Publish the valuation basis and disclosable sale terms before the decision.

comment: If utility access crosses the parcel, show how that access is protected in the transfer documents.

condition.requirement: Identify any utility access requirements and protect them in the transfer documents.
